skipped.title: 1945 Psalms and Lessons for the Christian Year (revised 1928 BCP daily-office table)
skipped.reason: Published 1945. A US work from 1931–1963 is public domain only if it appeared without a copyright notice or was not renewed. Websites that call it public domain are not a proof link. This pack did not complete a title-page and renewal-database check. Skip pending that proof. The original 1928 tables are used instead.

skipped.title: GitHub or other datasets that reproduce the Revised Common Lectionary tables
skipped.reason: The RCL citation table is copyrighted by the Consultation on Common Texts. A software license on a repository does not grant rights in those tables. The CCT permissions page requires written permission to post the tables on a website. LightUnto may consult RCL only for ideas, and must not host or copy the tables.
